_meta.headline: No price for any submitted product could be verified, and two common affiliate pricing features are prohibited outright.
_meta.method: Price/availability may only be shown if Amazon serves the link in which the data appears, or if it is obtained via Creators API / PA API under the IP License (SRC-10, Participation Requirements 2(b)). Both routes are unavailable here: the identifiers do not resolve and no API credentials were supplied.

rules.caption: Pricing rules the analysis layer must obey

rows.rule: Prices and availability may be shown only if Amazon serves the link containing them, or they come from Creators API / PA API under the License
rows.design: Two supply paths only; anything else (scraping, a third-party price API) is out of the build.

rows.rule: In any comparison layout, show BOTH the lowest "new" price and, where provided, the lowest "used" price on the Amazon Site
rows.design: The comparison template has mandatory `lowest_new` and `lowest_used` columns; a row missing them fails the render gate.

rows.rule: Price tracking and/or price alerting functionality is prohibited unless otherwise agreed by Amazon
rows.design: No watchlists, no drop alerts, no price-history chart. Internal analysis may still rank on price; it just may not be surfaced as a tracking feature.

rows.rule: If pricing is refreshed less often than hourly, a date/time stamp must sit adjacent to the price
rows.design: Renderer stamps every price cell at build time and refuses to print a price with no timestamp.

rows.rule: Pricing/availability disclaimer must be adjacent or reachable via link, pop-up or similar
rows.design: One canonical disclaimer partial, included by the price component itself — a page cannot render a price and skip it.

rows.rule: Non-image Program Content may be cached for at most 24 hours, and must then be refreshed and re-displayed
rows.design: Stale-while-revalidate capped at 24h; the publisher refuses to serve a price block older than 24h. ASINs are exempt and may be stored indefinitely.

rows.rule: Client applications may not store or cache Program Advertising Content
rows.design: No local persistence in any browser-side code; this site fetches nothing from Amazon at runtime.

rows.rule: Expired promotions must be removed as soon as the promotion ends
rows.design: `expires_at` is mandatory on any discount claim; the build skips expired claims and logs it.

rows.rule: No inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or misleading claims about products, prices, promotions or policies
rows.design: Claim validator ties every price or spec assertion to a named API field; unsourced superlatives are rejected.

gate.caption: What unblocks pricing analysis — in order

rows.action: Obtain the correct 10-character ASIN for each product
Approved Amazon Associates account and Associates tag
Creators API credentials (requires >=10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days)
Re-run `python3 tools/build_site.py` to publish verified prices with timestamps
